in_marathi.name: Nagaraju
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे King of Serpents
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nagaraju हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nagaraju is a Sanskrit name derived from two words: ‘Naga’ meaning serpent and ‘Raju’ meaning king. This name signifies the king of all serpents, a powerful deity and protector in Hindu mythology.
